## Summary

Describe the behavior or maintenance problem this change addresses.

## Scope

- [ ] Game contracts or version-sensitive values were updated where required.
- [ ] User-facing text was added through the centralized localization catalog.
- [ ] Runtime logging remains concise, English, and routed through `SmartLog`.
- [ ] No game files, third-party binaries, saves, logs, local configuration, or build artifacts are included.

## Verification

List the build command and any focused runtime or unit verification performed. Include the Idle Slayer, MelonLoader, and Idle Slayer Mods Core versions when the change touches game integration.

## Safety

Describe inventory costs, save impact, high-impact progression changes, compatibility risks, and the default state of any new option.
